label: World rule
description: One rule of how the story's world works, in magic, technology, law, custom or nature: what it says, what it costs, who knows it and how it shapes events. Places and groups belong to other kinds.

fields.label: Rule in one sentence
fields.help: The rule itself, stated plainly in a single sentence that a reader checking your draft for consistency could apply.

fields.label: What it governs
fields.help: The area of the world the rule belongs to, such as magic, technology, law, custom or nature, or another area you name.

fields.label: Who it applies to
fields.help: Whether the rule binds, or can be used by, everyone in the story's world or only some; where it stops applying belongs under its cost and limits.

options.label: Members of one group or people
Things or forces rather than people

fields.label: Source within the world
fields.help: Where the rule comes from inside the story's world, or a note that the story deliberately gives it no source.

fields.label: What keeps it in force
fields.help: What makes the rule go on holding now, as distinct from where it came from.

options.label: Its own nature; nothing enforces it
A force the story leaves unexplained

fields.label: Cost and limits
fields.help: What using, keeping or breaking the rule costs, and the point beyond which it stops applying.

fields.label: How absolute it is
fields.help: How strictly the rule holds in the story, from one that is often bent or broken to one that has never once been broken.

fields.label: Who knows it
fields.help: Who in the story understands the rule and how widely it is known, including any mistaken version most people hold.

fields.label: How much the reader is told
fields.help: How fully the book sets out the rule's workings for the reader, from leaving them a mystery to stating every condition.

fields.label: How the reader learns it
fields.help: When and through what the reader first learns the rule, and whether they grasp it before it decides anything that matters.

fields.label: Effect on everyday life
fields.help: How the rule and its cost show in ordinary life beyond the main characters, in work, trade, habit and belief.

fields.label: Consequences for the story
fields.help: How the rule shapes events and the choices characters make, including the choices it forbids them or forces on them.

fields.label: Continuity risks
fields.help: Points in the book where a draft could contradict the rule or its limits without meaning to, one per item, to check in revision.

fields.label: Change across the book
fields.help: Whether the rule itself alters, fails or proves other than it first seemed by the end of the book, and what brings that about.
